home_island_tutorial.scene: Morning at the village radio hut.

dialogue.speaker: Aling Rosa
dialogue.line: The market bell rang twice. That is not our morning signal.

dialogue.speaker: Jun
dialogue.line: The radio is hissing. Someone is trying to reach us.

earthquake.scene: A crack splits the path above the village.

dialogue.speaker: Berto
dialogue.line: The ridge just cracked. The trail is sliding toward the homes.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Mira Santos
dialogue.line: Under sturdy cover, everyone. Stay away from windows and walls.

flash_fire.scene: Smoke rises behind the market rooftops.

dialogue.speaker: Mayor Cruz
dialogue.line: The market fire is moving toward the power station.

dialogue.speaker: Nurse Joy
dialogue.line: I will take the clinic. Get families clear of the smoke.

harbor_flash_flood.chapter: CHAPTER 3 · TRAPPED BETWEEN LAND AND SEA
harbor_flash_flood.scene: Boats scrape the exposed harbor floor as the tide pulls back.

dialogue.speaker: Captain Reyes
dialogue.line: The sea is pulling away from the docks. Leave the boats.

dialogue.speaker: Mang Lito
dialogue.line: That is no ordinary tide. Move everyone to high ground.

plains_typhoon.chapter: CHAPTER 4 · THE TRUTH BENEATH THE SURFACE
plains_typhoon.scene: Rainwater spills over the rice-field channels.

dialogue.speaker: Kuya Ben
dialogue.line: The drainage gate is jammed. Water is crossing the fields.

dialogue.speaker: Mila
dialogue.line: These marks match the town records. Someone changed the controls.

silence_volcano.scene: Ash drifts across the valley road toward the mountain facility.

dialogue.speaker: Tatay Pio
dialogue.line: Ash is falling. The mountain has been quiet for too long.

dialogue.speaker: Engr. Paolo Santos
dialogue.line: The records point to the facility. Its control room is still powered.

final_shutdown.scene: The core pulses behind the control-room glass.

dialogue.speaker: Dr. Elias Voss
dialogue.line: I built the World Engine to control disasters. I lost control.

dialogue.speaker: Engr. Paolo Santos
dialogue.line: The shutdown relay is live. We have one safe chance.
